Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

On the death of a pensioner who has a joint bank account, the spouse may inform the bank through a simple letter, without Form 10 and request for commencement of family pension, along with a copy of death certificate, date of birth and an undertaking for recovery of  
PPO, proof of own age I excess payment.
